messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in **2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) – the holiday is observed on the nearest weekday if it falls on a weekend, but the actual day is still a holiday. |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | Not a long weekend, but often taken as a “holiday” day. |

**Provincial/territorial holidays that create long weekends in 2023**

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? |
|--------------------|---------|------|-------------|---------------|
| **Alberta** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |
| **British Columbia** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |
| **Manitoba** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |
| **New Brunswick** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |
| **Ontario** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |
| **Quebec** | St. Patrick’s Day | March 17 | Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) – observed as a statutory holiday in Quebec. |
| **Nova Scotia** | St. Patrick’s Day | March 17 | Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) – observed as a statutory holiday in Nova Scotia. |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | St. Patrick’s Day | March 17 | Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) – observed as a statutory holiday in NL. |
| **Prince Edward Island** | St. Patrick’s Day | March 17 | Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) – observed as a statutory holiday in PEI. |
| **Yukon** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |
| **Northwest Territories** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |
| **Nunavut** | Family Day | February 20 | Monday | No |

> **Quick takeaway:**  
> *The most common long weekends in Canada in 2023 were Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day (Saturday), Labour Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day. Provincial holidays such as St. Patrick’s Day in Quebec, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador, and Prince Edward Island also gave you a 3‑day break.*

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need the same information for other years or a more detailed breakdown (e.g., exact dates for each province), just let me know.
